text:
Lena B: FYI we got an inbound from Aurora KeyBridge - they want a joint marketplace tile + integration docs. Scope ask: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning with group filters, and PKCS#11 BYOK for customers. Can we assign owners and a minimal test plan? @Noah Green @Ivy Park

Noah Green: I'll take the marketplace copy and partner comms. Quick checklist I propose: 1) exchange SAML metadata and test accounts, 2) SCIM mapping + filter rules, 3) BYOK runbook for PKCS#11 + verification steps, 4) embargo/press timeline and assets.

Ivy Park: I can own the BYOK runbook. Security requires vendor attestations (FIPS or SOC2) and a short threat model for key import flows. Also SCIM must support "groupPrefix" filtering so partners cannot pull entire directories.

Lena B: For SAML the partner asked for SP-initiated and metadata URL. Example we can share (trimmed): <EntityDescriptor entityID="https://console.redwood.ai/saml/metadata">...</EntityDescriptor>. Add cert rotation notes and common failure modes (clock skew, cert mismatch).

Noah Green: SCIM sample payload we use in staging to create scoped users:
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "aurora-test@redwood.ai",
  "groups": [{"value":"aurora-eng","display":"aurora-eng"}]
}
We'll require a filter param like filter=groups.value sw "aurora-" and delta sync support.

Ivy Park: BYOK runbook outline: 1) exchange PKCS#11 module info and slot ids, 2) establish mutual TLS channel, 3) import wrapped key blob, 4) sample encrypt/decrypt test, 5) rotate and verify consumers. Rollback plan: failover to Redwood-managed keys with cutover scripts.

ops-bot: Created draft doc at https://docs.internal/partners/aurora-keybridge/playbook (editors: Lena,Noah,Ivy). Preflight checks queued: scim-smoke, saml-meta-check, pkcs11-verify.

Noah Green: For marketplace tile: need one-line positioning, 2 bullets of benefits, logos (SVG) and legal approval. I'll draft copy by Wed.

Lena B: Timeline: draft playbook by Tue EOD, internal review Wed, partner review Thu, target announcement in 18 days. Meeting tomorrow 9:30am PT to confirm owners and embargo contacts.

Ivy Park: Add audit event requirements: key-import, key-export (if applicable), key-rotate, admin-grant, and failed-auth attempts. Also capture sample log lines for our ingestion pipeline.

Noah Green: Acceptance test: provision user via SCIM with group aurora-ops => check entitlement in app => make a signed request that uses BYOK-wrapped key to decrypt a sample blob. Block GA if any step fails.

Lena B: Sounds good. I'll send invite and ping legal for asset clearances. :calendar: :lock:
